about_the_game:
Club Soko is a sokoban style puzzle game.

In Club Soko, the bouncers push you when you get too close. Read the room and outsmart all the visitors of each room using what you have around you. Each level is carefully crafted to teach you new, surprising and tricky ways of delving deeper and deeper into Club Soko~

Features

  • Use the bouncers predictable behaviors to venture into new dancefloors!

  • Use objects such as speakers, ravers, and moshers when making your way past bouncers isn't quite enough to get to the next dancefloor!

  • Explore 5 dancefloors each featuring their own distinct 2.5D visual style and musical themes.

  • Dance your way through over 30 handcrafted levels!

  • Secrets lurk deep down in Club Soko...
